summary: Capital Clean Energy Carriers Corp. (NASDAQ: CCEC), a Greek-domiciled foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing results of its Annual Meeting held September 22, 2026 in Piraeus. Shareholders re-elected seven directors, elected Janet DiFiore to the board, noted Gurpal Grewal's retirement after service since 2017, and ratified Deloitte Certified Public Accountants S.A. as independent auditor for fiscal 2026. This is a routine meeting-result disclosure, not a special situation; no transaction terms, advisor, premium, or regulatory clock are implicated. Watch only for future board-driven strategic actions.
